data_source: saved official 2023-2025 PDFs plus previously cached verified HTML; no HTTP403 retries
cohort: all structurally validated complete fields; unlinked horses retained with isolated source-row identity and zero cross-race history
unknown_official_IDs: remain NULL; never inferred official numbers
historical_availability: explicit 2-day and 7-day calendar assumptions, never PDF creation/modification time
payout_repair: ordered trifecta anchor, single/exacta/trio/wide checks, verify all original PDF hashes and reconcile overlapping HTML
evaluation_disclosure: 2025 already inspected; no claim of unseen holdout or live profitability
selection: 2024 mean log loss only; lower complexity on exact ties
reference_bet: maximum p times final odds >= 1.05; one 100-yen hypothetical win bet per race; horse-number tie break
promotion: research improvement requires lower paired log loss and higher same-rule final-odds return on both lag assumptions; never activate final-odds models for pre-off forecasts
